name: NGC 1854 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 1854, a globular cluster in the Large Magellanic Cloud, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc1854-hubble
story: A dense gathering of stars in the Large Magellanic Cloud, a satellite galaxy of the Milky Way. Hubble's sharp cameras can pick out individual stars even in the crowded cores of clusters like this one.

claims.text: NGC 1854 is in the Large Magellanic Cloud, a satellite galaxy of the Milky Way
Hubble can resolve individual stars even in crowded cluster cores
